title: The flow clone notice is a paragraph of engine prose; say it in one line (#27356 row 18)
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe

Filing gate: ③ triage-directed. #27356 row 18 was split by the seat's order: the Studio publish toast is done in PR #27882, and the clone notice is a server-lane card. This is that card, carded from PR #27882's report (6513596832, `out_of_scope_findings`).
Reach: Setup › Packaged automation › Clone on a packaged flow shows the notice verbatim (observed on the HotCRM Studio walkthrough, hotcrm#2320 S4; re-read on current `main`).
Reader who acts: `domain:server` (`packages/runtime`).
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "FLOW_CLONE_NOTICE flow clone notice shorten one line clone runs alongside original" → no open card covering it (#12156 and #21332 are closed and about the clone itself).

## Observed
The flow clone door answers `{ flow, notice }` with `FLOW_CLONE_NOTICE` (`packages/runtime/src/flow-clone.ts`): seven sentences that name `status draft`, lifecycle labels, the Packaged automation switch and the Studio Enabled switch. The console shows it as written. It already offers a "Switch the original off" button beside it, so most of the paragraph repeats what the screen offers.

## Wanted
One line in plain words, keeping what the reader must know: both flows run unless one is switched off. For example: "The copy runs alongside the original until you switch one of them off." Keep the detail (references not re-pointed, draft is not an off-switch, where each switch lives) in the TSDoc and the client SDK docs. Check pins that quote the sentence (runtime tests, console tests, docs).

Related: #27356 (row 18), PR #27882.
